about: The limits kit/compat.json is measured with, written before anything was measured. Copied from the kit: test/unit/stick-fits.test.mjs fails if one of them is no longer the kit's own. Changing this file makes every row of compat.json stale (its sha is in compat.json).

clip.frames: every frame of the whole clip as played, cloth and trims

accepted.from: kit/cast/clothsafe.js, its header: plain walking in a hanging garment is 7.3 cm a frame a frame on 9 frames against the limit of 6, the carry-bag walk 6.2-6.4 cm on one frame, both known and accepted on 25/11. Only this fault, on the adult body, up to these numbers; any other fault on the same clip blocks it

outfit.from: test/unit/wardrobe-measure.mjs trims(), the numbers of stick-wardrobe.test.mjs

mark.from: test/unit/stick-wardrobe-age.test.mjs, the share of a mark's card under the hat, front and 24 deg round
